Configure current feature

  1. Register zone.rillmere and zone.thornweald with reciprocal north/south gates; L_Thornweald needs only a receiving courtyard now.
  2. Run independent Zone_A and Zone_B processes on separate endpoints, backed by one trusted service. Configure reserve/full/timeout fixture switches and token signing keys outside content.
  3. Implement freeze/drain/snapshot/reservation/one-use redemption with epoch fencing BEFORE target writes. Route selected player via ClientTravel, never ServerTravel for this handoff.

Run now: current-phase integrated scenarios

  1. Connect A and B to Rillmere. A holds the persisted item GUID/currency/revision from05; B remains near the source gate.
  2. A uses north gate. Observe source freezes A, destination reserves, ticket redeems once, target epoch advances, one target body hydrates and loading screen closes only after readiness.
  3. Return A through Thornweald’s south gate. Repeat with packet loss and an interrupted client connection.
  4. Replay the consumed ticket and send a late source mutation with its old epoch. Exercise destination-full and crash-after-redemption fixtures.
Expected success
B remains on Zone_A and does not travel. A preserves accepted character records and never has two writable bodies.
Full destination before redemption safely resumes source; after redemption a crash recovers via current backend epoch to destination/safe hub, not the old source writer.

Explicitly not active yet

  1. Internal sublevel/World Partition streaming is separate and optional. No assumption that seamless travel moves live Actors between independent server processes.

current-phase fixtureDuplicate token and old epoch cannot create another body or replay initial rewards.

Regression, disconnect and restart

  1. Restart the test environment twice; one admitted pawn per account, one local input context installation, no stale widgets.
  2. Repeat the previous phase success case after all new assignments; definitions missing from this phase must fail closed, not fall back to client saves.
  3. From phase03 onward run two separate clients; disconnect A while B remains, then reconnect with the correct identity.
  4. From phase05 onward query committed receipt/revision after timeout/restart. From06 onward reject old source epoch after transfer.

Stop condition and deferred work

ClientTravel changes that client only; stale source writes and duplicate tickets reject.

Stop on a failed required assertion, missing required rule definition, duplicate authority or unverified dependency that this phase relies on. Legal debug art may support physics tests but cannot close the archive/PaperZD art gate. Do not activate future-phase systems merely because their full-game chapter exists.
